name: std/thread
description: Runs function-valued tasks and coordinates shared work with locks and conditions.
readme: Runs function-valued tasks and coordinates shared work with locks and conditions.
Import this module with use thread.

files.content:
-- Runs function-valued tasks and coordinates shared work with locks and conditions.
public define Thread as opaque.
public define Mutex as opaque.
public define Condition as opaque.
public use "thread" function spawn(task of type function taking () giving nothing) of type fallible pointer to Thread.
public use "thread" function wait(task of type pointer to Thread) of type fallible nothing.
public use "thread" function mutex() of type fallible pointer to Mutex.
public use "thread" function lock(mutex of type pointer to Mutex) of type fallible nothing.
public use "thread" function unlock(mutex of type pointer to Mutex) of type fallible nothing.
public use "thread" function condition() of type fallible pointer to Condition.
public use "thread" function signal(condition of type pointer to Condition) of type fallible nothing.
public use "thread" function pause(condition of type pointer to Condition, mutex of type pointer to Mutex) of type fallible nothing.
public use "thread" function close[T](resource of type pointer to T) of type fallible nothing.
